test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. The last exam of the year was history, which had always been my worst subject.

B. So, I decided to write the dates and names of the important events on the inside of my arm.

C. This happened when I was about 14 years old.

D. I was useless at remembering dates and people's names
solution:
The correct answer is '**CADB**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of a Sentence Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• Sentence C in the given question is the starting of an incident. The author is talking about an event when he was 14 years old.
 
• Sentence A will be the next sentence as it tells us that very incident.
 
• Sentence D will be the next sentence because the author tells us that he considered it useless to remember dates and people's names.
 
• Lastly, Sentence B will be used.
 
• Thus, the sequence becomes:
 
 
• C: This happened when I was about 14 years old.
 
• A: The last exam of the year was history, which had always been my worst subject.
 
• D: I was useless at remembering dates and people's names
 
• B: So, I decided to write the dates and names of the important events on the inside of my arm.
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct Sequence:__ *This happened when I was about 14 years old. The last exam of the year was history, which had always been my worst subject. I was useless at remembering dates and people's names. So, I decided to write the dates and names of the important events on the inside of my arm.*
